div.head: ECf 32 B 9
div.ab: Et ut warde iuste et rite obseruentur, et ut caute deinceps pro incendiis sibi illic prouideant, cum ad propria redibunt.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 657 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints across the page as an insertion into ECf retr. 32 (32 A–E, pp. 655–660). The dictionary cites it as “ECf 32 B …”, so it is kept with ECf here.

note.seg: dieser Artikel wendet sich zunächst an Londons Aldermen; ähnlich Wl art. retr. 6
this article is addressed first to the aldermen of London; similarly Wl art. retr. 6
noch gehört die Feuerpolizei nicht wie später den Wardmoots, sondern dem Folcmot auch nach Municipal coll. ed. Bateson Engl. hist. rev. 1902, 502
fire control does not yet belong, as later, to the wardmoots, but to the folkmoot, also according to Municipal coll., ed. Bateson, Engl. hist. rev. 1902, 502
